names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Αβέρκιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας», with the rank word left off; the page's own body gives his name in the world as «Πολύκαρπος Κεδρώφ».

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε στις 2 Μαρτίου 1879 μ.Χ. στην πόλη Γιαράνσκ της επαρχίας Βυάτκα».

death.note: saint.gr: «συνελήφθη και καταδικάσθηκε, το 1937 μ.Χ., στον διά τυφεκισμού θάνατο», and its head line reads «Αγιος Αβερκιος ο Ιερομαρτυρας (1879 - 1937)».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Αβέρκιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is neither of the two Abercii the corpus holds**: `abercius-of-hierapolis` is the equal-to-the-apostles of the second century and `abercius-martyr-26-may` is a martyr kept on another day; this is Polycarp Kedrov of Yaransk, tonsured in 1910 and made a bishop in 1915. **The office in the corpus's English is the page's «Επίσκοπος της περιοχής»** after his rectorship of the church school of Zhytomyr, which is the only see the page names for him. **Patriarch Tikhon is linked** because the page places him at his funeral in 1925, which is an encounter and not a dedication. **Sergius Stragorodsky, archbishop of Finland, who tonsured him, is named without a link**, the corpus keeping no folder for him. **No hymn. The page does not say where he was shot.**
